articles.title: Amazon launches Alexa's 'Update Me When' to sen...
articles.description: Amazon introduced a new AI feature in its Alexa for Shopping assistant called "Update Me When," which sends personalized notifications about new or relevant events that could prompt purchases. This feature helps users track product launches, TV show releases, concert tours, book publications, and tech product announcements. It marks a shift from Alexa only responding to direct queries to proactively anticipating purchase triggers. Other Alexa shopping features include price tracking with automatic buying options, personalized deals, shopping guides, and AI product overviews, enhancing the overall shopping experience.

articles.title: Major China smartphone makers increase prices
articles.description: MAJOR Chinese smartphone makers, including Huawei, Xiaomi and Honor, raised prices on selected models on Tuesday by between 200 yuan ($28) and 1,000 yuan ($140), spanning flagship and mid-range devices, as rising costs for memory chips and mobile processors increasingly feed through to consumers.
